|translation='''Title:''' Beru Lars.

'''Card text:''' Forfeit +2 when at the same location as [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]] or at [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]]. If she goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

'''Lore:''' [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]]'s wife and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian. She urges her husband Owen to let Luke enter the Imperial Academy. She manages the farm's hydroponics station.
